cohort: 60 women with massive Post-Cesarean Section Hemorrhage (PCSH) at Suqian Maternity and Children's Hospital from January 2020 to July 2022
finding: Compared to allogeneic blood transfusion, intraoperative cell salvage in women with severe PCSH may lead to improved postoperative blood parameters, faster coagulation function recovery, and a lower risk of adverse events.
